flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, streamed answer

steps.note: host selectable: chatglm.cn (zh) or chat.z.ai (intl); session snapshots injected (data/{host}/.session); may land on a consent/auth interstitial first run — click through, then proceed
selector [aria-label="新对话"] / [aria-label="New Chat"] (profile.json — UNVERIFIED, confirm on first live capture); jittered 600-1300ms human dwell
trusted keyboard.insertText into div[contenteditable=true] (fallback textarea[placeholder*=输入] / textarea[placeholder*=Message]) — UNVERIFIED selectors

rpc: underlying wire depends on host. chatglm.cn (zh): POST /chatglm/backend-api/v1/stream_context?__requestid={uuid} (EventSource-style, isEventSourceaOpen flag; wire format TBD — SSE/NDJSON/chunked JSON to verify on live capture) + POST /chatglm/backend-api/v1/manualstop to interrupt. Auth: cookie chatglm_token (Bearer), refresh via /chatglm/user-api/user/refresh. chat.z.ai (intl): POST /api/chat/completions (SSE text/event-stream via fetch reader, OpenAI-format body {stream, model, messages, params}) — Authorization: Bearer {localStorage.token}. The UI path drives the site's own JS so no proto reconstruction needed.
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing
